card.title: How To Fix an iPhone SE 2020 with No Touch and/or 3 Min Restart, Mic1 Problem

source.title: How To Fix an iPhone SE 2020 with No Touch and/or 3 Min Restart, Mic1 Problem

claims.statement: iPhone SE 2020 has a design defect where three lines under the SIM tray break inside the PCB: SPI_AP_TO_TOUCH_CS_CONN_L (touch) and I2C1_AP_SCL / I2C1_AP_SDA (Mic1), causing no touch and/or 3-minute restarts.
Touch CS line reads about 0.366 and the I2C1 lines about 0.329 in diode mode; OL, or values that change when pressing on the SIM tray area, confirm the board fault.
Fix with three long jumpers: touch CS from C5770 at the LCD connector to the trace dug out between the SIM tray and U3600; SCL from R6610 to C6456; SDA from R6611 to C6466. Run all three every time.

procedure: Test known-good screen and charge port flex.
Diode-check the three lines; press near the SIM tray to look for changes.
Run all three jumpers; UV-mask them.
Verify readings, then test touch and run a stopwatch past 3 minutes.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
